255768.title: Police Story

257155.title: The Extraordinary Adventures of Adele Blanc-Sec

257167.title: City Hunter

257298.title: The Protector
257298.description: The Protector stars Jackie Chan and Danny Aiello (Do the Right Thing) as a pair of NYPD cops sent to Hong Kong to catch a drug lord who has kidnapped the daughter of his former associate. This 1985 martial arts film was written and directed by James Glickenhaus (The Exterminator).

262772.title: Penny Serenade

262781.title: The Strange Love of Martha Ivers
262781.description: He's the only one who knows her dark secret, so the ruthless Martha weds her childhood friend Walter to keep things quiet... but for how long?

268511.title: Black Snake Moan

268512.title: Bound

268513.title: Candyman Farewell to the Flesh
268513.description: A New Orleans teacher discovers the link between a series of mysterious killings and the spirit of an unjustly murdered slave, in this horror sequel.

268518.title: The Four Feathers
268518.description: Harry Feversham, a British soldier with a golden future - inexplicably resigns from his regiment. Harry is branded a coward,  disowned by his family, his beautiful fiancee and his best friend. Heartbroken and abandoned, Harry receives news that his regiment has been brutally attacked by Sundanese rebels. Suddenly Harry's course becomes clear and he sets out on an unforgettable journey to regain his honor, recapture his love, and save the lives of his comrades.

268521.title: Home for the Holidays
268521.description: A single mom,  who has just lost her job and her self-confidence,  travels home for the dreaded annual Thanksgiving gathering with her relatives.

268522.title: I'll Sleep When I'm Dead
268522.description: A former gang leader (Clive Owen) who had retired to a quiet life in the English countryside is drawn back into the city and the business to avenge the gruesome murder of his brother.

268530.title: Margot at the Wedding
268530.description: Margot Zeller (Nicole Kidman) is a short story writer with a sharp wit and an even sharper tongue. On the eve of her estranged sister Pauline's (Jennifer Jason Leigh) wedding to unemployed musiciartist/depressive Malcolm (Jack Black) at the family seaside home,  Margot shows up unexpectedly to rekindle the sisterly bond and offer her own brand of "support." What ensues is a nakedly honest and subversively funny look at family dynamics.

268533.title: A Mighty Heart
268533.description: Based on a harrowing true story, Mariane Pearl frantically searches for her journalist husband, Daniel, after he goes missing in Pakistan.

268535.title: Narc
268535.description: A narcotics officer investigates the killing of a rookie cop, teaming up with the cop's former partner, but soon discovers that he has been set up.

268536.title: Ordinary People
268536.description: A wealthy family’s lives are torn apart by the death of the oldest son while the younger son struggles against suicide and guilt from the accident.

268540.title: The Perfect Score
268540.description: A comic crime film about six high school teens who conspire to break into a SAT testing center to steal the answers in hope of acing their exam.

268541.title: Perfume: The Story of a Murderer
268541.description: Jean-Baptiste Grenouille, born with no smell, develops a superior olfactory sense, which he uses to create the world's finest perfumes. His work, however, takes a dark turn as he searches for the ultimate scent.

268547.title: Thinner
268547.description: An obese attorney accidentally runs down and kills an old gypsy woman. After her ancient father puts a curse on him,  he starts losing weight,  and cannot stop. Based on the Stephen King novel,  written under the pseudonym Richard Bachman.

269874.title: Circle of Iron
269874.description: Aspiring-martial artist Cord lives in a desert-like world where nearly everyone he meets practices or has practised a martial art. He seeks to find the place where the true inner spirit of the martial arts is being taught.

272763.title: Crime Story
272763.description: Inspector Eddie Chan fights mobsters, corruption, and his own personal demons as he searches for a kidnapped business man in Hong Kong and Taiwan.

273562.title: Frankie and Johnny
273562.description: Pfeiffer plays Frankie, a waitress at a N.Y.C. coffee shop. After a series of hurtful relationships, the last thing Frankie's looking for is a new manuntil he comes looking for her.

273579.title: Angus, Thongs and Perfect Snogging
273579.description: Georgia likes the new guy at school, Robbie. Robbie happens to already be dating Georgia's evil archrival: Lindsay. With the help of her parents, her cat Angus and her girl posse, Georgia sets out to get herself a boyfriend!

278533.title: The Dead Zone
278533.description: Christopher Walken (Catch Me If You Can) wakes from a coma due to a car accident, only to find he has lost five years of his life, and yet gained psychic powers. Foreseeing the future appears to be a "gift" at first,  but ends up causing problems... David Cronenberg directs this thriller based on the Stephen King novel.

278535.title: Jade
278535.description: A San Francisco District Attorney faces a potential conflict of interest when he learns that the prime suspect in his murder case an old flame.

278541.title: Vampire in Brooklyn
278541.description: As the vampire Maximillian, Eddie Murphy is the most diabolical, dashing and definitely undead dude in the 'hood'.

279480.title: Woochi
279480.description: Jeon Woo-chi, an undisciplined, womanizing wizard unjustly accused of the death of his master, is trapped inside an ancient scroll until he is set free in 2009 to help fight against evil goblins that have taken over present-day Korea.

281658.title: Becoming Barack
281658.description: An intimate portrait of a young man destined to make history. Includes a never-before-seen lost interview. Becoming Barack: Evolution of a Leader traces the early path of a man destined to make history and to be a catalyst for global change. Features footage from three of the earliest known recorded interviews with Barack Obama and includes excerpts from Obama's audio book reading of Dreams of My Father.

281664.title: Inside the 50 Shades: Real Women Confess
281664.description: An exploration of the dominance and submission lifestyle as revealed in the best-selling book trilogy Fifty Shades of Grey. In this film, real women and men reveal their experiences, wants and desires as dominant and submissive participants.

281682.title: Tupac Vs.
281682.description: Tupac Shakur remains a controversial and misunderstood figure long after the shooting that ended his life. Featuring an in-depth, never before seen 1995 interview, rare footage and stills, interviews from manager Leila Steinberg and more.

286035.title: Buying Sex
286035.description: Buying Sex brings forward the voices of sex workers, formerly prostituted women, policy-makers, lawyers and even the male buyers. All agree that they want to improve the workers safety, but have polarized philosophies about how that can be best achieved. Respecting differences of ideology and opinion as Canada works its way toward an uneasy consensus. Buying Sex challenges us to question whether prostitution is the oldest profession or the oldest oppression.

286039.title: Children of the Light
286039.description: "Children of the Light" tells the life story of Desmond Tutu of South Africa. With extensive archival footage, family photos and never before seen interviews, this film shares the legacy of one of the greatest peacemakers of our time.

286904.title: Time Out
286904.description: Many people believe in life after death, but not Doctor Tirsa. The practical and skeptical doctor has always refused to believe in such nonsenseuntil the day he is hit by a bowling ball and wakes up in an open field surrounded by others like himself  people who have left our world and not yet made it to the next. Suddenly Doctor Tirsa realizes that his life was not all that bad and that he has a good reason to return.

289622.title: Perfect Sisters
289622.description: Two sisters who are fed up with their alcoholic mother’s abusive boyfriends plan to kill her and collect the insurance money in this crime drama.

Two years later, John has become Sydney's partner.

303151.title: Like Crazy

303155.title: Paranormal Activity 2

303157.title: Paranormal Activity 4
303157.description: After disappearing with her nephew and no other survivors, Katie returns five years later with a mysterious boy, ready to target new victims.

304525.title: Beowulf

304534.title: Over The Top

305361.title: The Pornographer

305423.title: Beyond Borders

305426.title: Bloodsport
305426.description: Frank Dux has spent most his life being trained by Tanaka to participate in the Kumite, the ultimate martial arts tournament.

305461.title: Jacob's Ladder

While there, he meets beautiful barmaid Camilla, a Mexican immigrant who hopes for a better life by marrying a wealthy American.

312939.description: When long-lost Uncle Fester reappears after twenty-five years in the Bermuda Triangle, Gomez and Morticia plan a celebration to wake the dead.

313750.title: De Regreso a la Escuela Con Franklin
313750.description: Se terminó el verano y Franklin y sus amigos regresan a clases. Franklin está emocionado por volver a ver al Sr. Búho, pero se lleva una gran sorpresa al llegar a la escuela y enterarse de que su maestro tuvo que viajar por un problema familiar y tienen una maestra substituta. Al principio Franklin está renuente a los cambios que la maestra nueva hace, pero después de conocerla se hacen buenos amigos y aprende que el cambio es bueno para todos y hace la vida más divertida.

313751.title: Franklin y el tesoro del lago
313751.description: Un verano tranquilo jugando a los piratas da un giro sorpresivo para FRANKLIN cuando aparece su tía viajera, LUCY, con su ahijada ansiosa de aventuras, SAM.  Un misterioso mapa del tesoro lleva a Franklin y sus amigos al Lago de las Tortugas en busca de un talismán enterrado hace tiempo del que esperan pueda curar a su ABUELA enferma. Por el camino, los aventureros reciben la ayuda de tres aliados inesperados: la vieja y sabia ANCIANA TORTUGA, la traviesa CUERVITA, y el gruñón oso de montaña, el SR. GRIZZLY. Con su ayuda, Franklin encuentra un tesoro perdido ¡y con ello descubre el verdadero significado de la familia y la amistad! Únanse a la tortuga favorita de todos en una emocionante aventura llena de sorpresas mientras Franklin aprende que X no siempre marca el lugar y los tesoros a veces no son lo que parecen

314064.title: Inside
314064.description: His first night in prison, Miles wants his life back but instead jerks awake to the sounds of a murder — and realizes the killer is coming for him.

314135.title: Amorous
314135.description: 4 Londoners move to an isolated country cottage to test social conventions and their own inhibitions by swapping partners and exploring unconventional sexual relationships.Their new personal and sexual bonds are tested by the arrival of an ex-lover.

314136.title: And They Call It Summer
314136.description: Emotional scars keep Dino from having sex with his wife Anna so he satisfies his urges with prostitutes, while seeking out Anna's ex-lovers to please her. Mired in a labyrinth of perversion, Anna tries to ease Dino's pain.

314320.title: The Collector
314320.description: To repay a debt, an ex-con plans to rob his boss's home but, unbeknownst to him, someone has imprisoned the family and planted traps everywhere.

314511.title: 22 Bullets
314511.description: Having been left for dead with 22 bullets in his body after being shot by a former childhood friend, a retired mobster sets out to get his revenge.

314516.title: Clear and Present Danger
314516.description: When his mentor Admiral James Greer becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence. He now must investigate the murder of one of the President's friends, a prominent U.S. businessman with secret ties to Colombian drug cartels.

314517.title: World Trade Center
314517.description: The true story of two police officers who rush into the World Trade Center to rescue people and get trapped in the rubble when it collapses on 9/11.

314546.title: Superstar
314546.description: All Mary Katherine Gallagher wants in life is a kiss. Not just any kiss, a Hollywood-style kiss. But no matter how hard she tries, no one will kiss her. She decides that to get her kiss, she must become just like the people in the movies.

314551.title: The Last Castle
314551.description: A court-martialed general is sent to a military prison and leads a revolt against the corrupt system when he finds his fellow inmates are being murdered.

314554.title: The Ruins
314554.description: A group of friends struggle for survival after visiting a remote archaeological dig, where they discover something deadly living among the ruins.

314816.title: Forces of Nature
314816.description: When his flight to his wedding is grounded, Ben desperately joins quirky Sarah for a road trip home, but nature may be trying to tell him something.

316420.title: Bloodrayne (Unrated)
316420.description: After escaping a travelling circus, an 18th century vampire joins a group of vampire hunters to avenge the her mother's rape — and kill her father.

316421.title: Bloodrayne 2: Deliverance (Unrated)
316421.description: In the nineteenth century, a half-vampire human must fight off Billy the Kid and his vampire gang when she arrives in the Wild West.

319703.title: Bullhead
319703.description: A cattle farmer makes a deal with a illegal hormone dealer, leading to a series of events that force him to face his demons in this crime drama.

321249.title: Zeitgeist: The Movie
321249.description: Explore contrary perspectives on everyday cultural issues in this documentary devoted to mythology, belief, and conspiracy in society today.

321251.title: Hell Baby
321251.description: In this horror-comedy, an expectant couple calls the Vatican's exorcism team for help delivering an evil child after they move into a haunted house.

321995.title: 5 Broken Cameras
321995.description: A documentary on a Palestinian farmer's chronicle of his nonviolent resistance to the actions of the Israeli army via recording it all on video.

322719.title: The Secret
322719.description: This self-help film uses documentary-style interviews with experts to explore the Law of Attraction—the theory that you attract the energy you exude.

322939.title: School of Rock
322939.description: Kicked out of his band, a deadbeat guitarist becomes a substitute teacher at a private school where he tries to teach the children how to rock.

322940.title: The Legend of Bagger Vance
322940.description: A disillusioned war veteran, Rannulph Junah, agrees to play a game of golf. He finds the game futile until his caddy, Bagger Vance, teaches him the secret of the authentic golf stroke.

322948.title: Timeline
322948.description: A group of archaeologists must travel back in time to fourteenth-century France to rescue their professor during the Hundred Years War.

322949.title: Ghost Town
322949.description: After a near-death experience, an ill-tempered dentist develops the ability to see dead people who want him to complete their unfinished business.

322952.title: Alfie
322952.description: When the consequences of his playboy lifestyle affect the women in his life and his best friend, Alfie begins to wonder if there is more to life.

322955.title: The Manchurian Candidate
322955.description: As the nation watches the presidential campaign head towards Election Day, one man races to uncover a conspiracy that could destroy democracy itself.

322959.title: The Uninvited
322959.description: A girl returns from a mental institution after her mother’s death, suspicious of her new stepmother when the ghost of her mom accuses her of murder.

324964.title: Sound City
324964.description: Explore the history of the fabled California recording studio through the memories of the artists who worked there in this music lovers' documentary.

325076.title: Zeitgeist: Addendum
325076.description: In this controversial conspiracy documentary that sparked the social movement of the same name, filmmaker Peter Joseph uses animation and historical footage to explain global events and present an unprecented new theory of world affairs.

327226.title: Fish Tank
327226.description: Angry and alone, Mia’s one outlet in her hard life is dance—until her mother’s new boyfriend changes everything in this brutal coming-of-age drama.

327236.title: My Brother the Pig
327236.description: After her bully of a brother turns into a pig, a girl sets off on an adventure to Mexico to find her nanny's grandmother and set things right.

329408.title: Shelter
329408.description: An underground bomb shelter holds survivors in the wake of a nuclear winter, but their one-world civilization isn't big enough for the five of them.

332351.title: Kitten Party
332351.description: Meet Whiskers and all of his kitten friends as they throw a fun filled Kitten Party! Educational for kids and fun for animal lovers of all ages!

333042.title: Autumn Romance
333042.description: One day, an old man walks into a wedding photograph studio; he wants to surprise his sick wife with a romantic wedding photograph experience. The manager of the studio is very touched by their story and at the same time, there are some subtle changes in her life…

333043.title: Come Home, Mom
333043.description: Xiao Hui lives with his uncle but he is always upset,because his parents are out for work and seldom come back home. Lacking of parental love and derided by other children making him desire to see his parents even more. What he doesn't know is his parents already passed away, for not letting him know this, his uncle even cut all the newspapers in the village. Xiao Hui pestering Laoguai Li from the snack shop, talking about finding his mom again and again. Laoguai Li is annoyed by him and gave him a phone number conveniently, letting him find his mom by this. Would this call get through?

333045.title: First Love
333045.description: This is a story about first love demonstrated by the director's exquisite shooting skill.

333046.title: Flee away
333046.description: With the tremendous obstruction of the family, Ting decides to run away with Di. However, Ting’s parents suit Di kidnapping their daughter by using the personal relationships with the police department. Ting and Di try to escape the pursuit of the police officers by riding a motorcycle…how far they can go, how long they can hold up against the physical, emotional and psychological struggles.

333047.title: Forgotten Radio Station
333047.description: If you lost memory,does everything existing in this world still mean anything to you？.This story's boy is a delivery man,however, this job for him is not just for earning money but for some more important reason---looking for his father who lost his way because of alzheimer.Film is short but it's pretty moving.Pay tribute to the greatest love of father.

333051.title: Sixth Rider
333051.description: The “Black glove” has killed the previous victors of the car-racing contest. Bo is the winner of the 6th car-racing contest. After obtaining the championship, he is surrounded by the fear and anxiousness. He continuously receives the photos and horror DVDs about the previous victims and the warnings from the anonymous person…..

333052.title: Strange Battle
333052.description: This film is adapted from a true strange event happened in Xiangxi.It narrates a mysterious story about the driving dead body and miasma.

333057.title: Would You Marry Me
333057.description: A material girl, Si TIAN, kicked away her white collar boyfriend, Nan BAI,and start a relatioship with a man from a rich family, but it seems there's many problems between them.

334622.title: Survivor
334622.description: A spacecraft searching for a habitable planet crash lands on a barren world, leaving the survivors to face post-apocalyptic warriors and mutated savages.

337825.title: Afternoon Delight
337825.description: An unhappy housewife takes her husband to a strip club to spice things up but when she invites a stripper to be their nanny, their lives unravel.

337827.title: New York, I Love You
337827.description: In neighborhoods all across New York City, a series of romantic stories unfold in the city that never sleeps, where love is on everyone's mind.

337829.title: The English Teacher
337829.description: An English teacher lives vicariously through her novels but when an unintended tryst with a former student goes public, her life turns upside down.

339342.title: Bullet Boy
339342.description: A minor confrontation in the streets of East London spirals out of control, sweeping a young boy into the fray with calamitous consequences.

342067.title: Zapped
342067.description: A teenager who struggles to adjust to her new stepfamily and school receives some help when a dog training app gives her the power to control boys.

346260.title: Love & Sex in an Age of Pornography
346260.description: This documentary looks beyond fantasy, exploring the intimate lives of young people in the era of easily accessible porn and the porn industry of L.A.

356408.title: Soaked In Bleach: Kurt Cobain
356408.description: The events behind Kurt Cobain's death as seen through the eyes of Tom Grant, the private investigator hired by Courtney Love to track down her missing husband (Kurt Cobain) only days before his deceased body was found. The film develops as a narrative mystery with cinematic re-creations, interviews with key experts and witnesses and the examination of official artifacts from the 1994 case.

363091.title: 20,000 Days On Earth
363091.description: In this dreamy combination of documentary and dramatic storytelling, examines the creativity, life and collaborations of music icon Nick Cave.

363094.title: Night Moves
363094.description: Three radical environmentalists plan the ultimate protest: destroying a hydroelectric dam. But can they can reconcile their ideals with their plot?

364440.title: Freetown
364440.description: Caught in the middle of a brutal civil war, six Liberian missionaries in Monrovia flee the widespread violence of their native country. Their destination: Freetown, Sierra Leone. With the help of local church leader Phillip Abubakar, the missionaries make the difficult journey, only to have their troubles compounded by a rebel fighter bent on killing one of their own.

367709.title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
367709.description: Far beneath the earth’s surface, a research team becomes trapped after they discover a fantastical, impossible world where dinosaurs roam.

367720.title: Mega Shark vs Giant Octopus
367720.description: Two prehistoric sea creatures, a mega shark and a giant octopus, fight to the death on the California coast. Who will reign supreme over the sea?

368165.title: Restored Me
368165.description: An ex-con who lost his faith in God joins the crew of an old movie theater to start a new life, but soon finds the theater will test him in new ways.

371099.title: Trigun: Badlands Rumble
371099.description: Twenty years ago, Vash the Stampede allowed an infamous outlaw named Gasback to escape final justice. Now, on the streets of Macca City, Vash is about to learn a hard truth about consequences - and he might end up paying for the lesson with his life.

372421.title: A Kingdom for the Dzanga Gorillas
372421.description: Deep in the heart of darkness in the lush rain forest of the Congo, is a woman with a very big heart. Italian scientist Chloe Cipoletta has dedicated her life to protecting and studying a remarkable family of lowland gorillas.Until now, these wonderful animals have lived a quiet, secret life away from people. But with human development on the horizon, the race is now on to ensure that Congo s gorillas have a permanent home in the future.Chloe's solution is radical, yet simple: she wants to habituate a family of gorillas to human contact. If she succeeds then a whole new tourist industry will be born, as well as a good financial reason to protect the forest home of one of humankind s closest relations.

372440.title: A Turtle's Tale: Sammy's Adventures
372440.description: Sammy the sea turtle and his friend Ray swim around the world, enduring the challenges of the oceans in search of Shelly, the love of Sammy's life.

379489.title: Pixel Poetry
379489.description: In this film, through the voices of many within the industry, we discuss the benefits that video games have created for everyday people, as well as the challenges they have faced in being legitimized as art and the alleged violent and addictive qualities they are claimed to have. Along with this, we also discuss the effects of the indie community on games, and how video games are being embraced in everyday life.

382209.title: Justin Bieber: Limitless
382209.description: From YouTube phenomenon to bad boy pop megastar, follow the unique journey of superstar prodigy Justin Bieber as he grows from newly signed teenager into a contemporary pop celebrity with a string of scandals to boot.

382211.title: Justin Timberlake: Man of the Hour
382211.description: A unique look at the rise of one of the world's biggest superstars and ultimate triple-threats, Justin Timberlake.

382213.title: Lady Gaga: The Art of Music
382213.description: Exploitative, Excessive, and Cutting Edge. And that's just her music! Lady Gaga has redefined the boundaries of where a pop icon can go-both on stage and off. As one of the industry's leading (and most controversial) performers, Lady Gaga shows no signs of slowing down her music and fashion innovations.

382223.title: Michael Jackson: The Journey
382223.description: From modest childhood beginnings to international fame and fortune, follow the journey behind Michael Jackson's fantastic career and witness the King of Pop's transformation from boyhood sensation to international superstar.

382225.title: Miley Cyrus: Unleashed
382225.description: From America's sweetheart to America's devilish problem child, Miley Cyrus has grown up before our eyes and exposed just about everything legally allowed. She's redefined how far a televised stage performance can go, all while having the world `twerking' to see her next moves.

382230.title: If I Had Wings
382230.description: A blind teenager’s dream comes true when he finds an unlikely running partner who helps him join his school’s competitive cross-country team.

382245.title: Eminem: A Shady Story
382245.description: With his brilliant-and controversial-take on hip hop, rap artist Eminem exploded onto the Billboard charts and quickly became one of the most influential performers in the world. From his troubled childhood to selling over 100 million albums globally, "A Shady Story" presents the often overlooked genius behind the work of Marshall Mathers. including interviews with industry experts and unseen footage and clips from his most popular hits.

382397.title: Alone Yet Not Alone
382397.description: Alone Yet Not Alone tells the inspiring story of Barbara and Regina Leininger and their journey of faith and survival during the French & Indian war in 1755. Captured by the Allegheny Indians in a raid on their home and transported over 300 miles of wilderness to Ohio, the sisters are sustained only by their abiding trust in God, and their hope of escape against all odds to be reunited with their family.

383706.title: Hope
383706.description: A young man hits rock bottom and nowhere to turn. With the loss of all hope, desire and motivation. He is slowly build back up through faith and trust in God.

384055.title: Mythica: A Quest for Heroes
384055.description: Young wizard Marek joins forces with an unlikely band of heroes for an epic rescue mission, as they face a series of fantastic and magical enemies.

384477.title: The Beach Boys - Doin' It Again
384477.description: The Beach Boys are America's most successful band. With 56 U.S. Top 100 hits, 36 Top Ten Hits, and 4 Number One singles, their impression on American pop culture is rivaled only by the band that considered them to be their sole competition, The Beatles. To mark the group's 50th anniversary, Brian Wilson, Mike Love, Al Jardine, Bruce Johnston, and David Marks gathered in 2012 for an emotional reunion to record their first album of new material in 20 years, to kick off a worldwide tour, and to reflect on their remarkable history.

384478.title: The Art of McCartney
384478.description: An iconic songwriter and performer, Paul McCartney has been providing the soundtrack to millions of peoples lives for over half a century. This documentary explores the making of a remarkable album: The Art of McCartney features the finest artists of today paying their respect to the greatest. In this film you are going to hear from some of the artists who shaped The Art of McCartney, sharing their thoughts about Paul's music and the songs they have recorded.

384480.title: Norwegian Wood
384480.description: Published in 1987 and since translated into 33 languages, Norwegian Wood is a story of loss and heartbreak in a time of global instability. Haruki Murakami's bestselling novel is brought to the screen by Tran Anh Hung (Golden Lion winner for "Cyclo" and Academy Award nominee for "The Scent of Green Papaya") and features Japanese rising star Kenichi Matsuyama and Oscar nominee Rinko Kikuchi alongside newcomer Kiko Mizuhara. Tokyo, the late 1960s: Students around the world are uniting to overthrow the establishment and Toru Watanabe's personal life is similarly in tumult. At heart, he is deeply devoted to his first love, Naoko, a beautiful and introspective young woman. But their complex bond has been forged by the tragic death of their best friend years before. Watanabe lives with the influence of death everywhere. That is, until Midori, a girl who is everything that Naoko is not - outgoing, vivacious, supremely self-confident - marches into his life and Watanabe must choose between his past and his future.

385360.title: Bible Conspiracies
385360.description: Hidden in the Bible are ancient secrets. The marriage of Jesus and Mary and their children; the destruction of the tower of Babel by an alien race called the Anunnaki, and the hidden code that holds the revelation about future events.

385365.title: A Gamer's Life
385365.description: In this documentary about an unconventional career, two professional gamers share tips and tricks on how they earn money from playing video games.

386215.title: House of Grace
386215.description: A homeless, crack-addicted woman is inspired by a nearby church to turn her life around, while her down-and-out boyfriend spirals out of control.

386223.title: I Used to Love Her
386223.description: A singer loses her way when a man betrays her trust. On the path to find herself, she falls for someone new. Will her past ruin her future?

386233.title: Fake Preacher
386233.description: A Harlem con man pretends to be a preacher in order to steal money from the congregation. As conflicts develop, he seeks a way to redeem himself.

386241.title: Basketball 3:16
386241.description: As a young man grows up and allows God into his life, he begins to see Him in every aspect of his life — even on the basketball court.

387309.title: Sad Vacation: The Last Days of Sid and Nancy
387309.description: Sad Vacation is a personal account of the tumultuous and stormy relationship between Sid Vicious and Nancy Spungen and how it ended in Room 100 of the Chelsea Hotel. Directed by Danny Garcia, this films pulls no punches and reveals the facts through personal friends, insiders and witnesses. Includes interviews with Sylvain Sylvain, Bob Gruen, Walter Lure, Leee Black Childers, and many more.

389126.title: Da Sweet Blood of Jesus
389126.description: Cursed by an ancient African artifact from a long-lost tribe, an anthropologist finds himself with an insatiable, addictive thirst for human blood.

391666.title: How to Love
391666.description: Max is a fast talking mercenary willing to risk everything for the almighty dollar, but he has met his match when he agrees to take on a job to terminate the devil himself. With the help of an elite assassin and the last remaining member of the Knights Templar, Max prepares for battle. But will the team even stand a chance against the mightiest demon they all have ever faced?

392048.title: Book of Songs
392048.description: High school dropout and aspiring musician, Mike, spends his days hanging out with his friends and confronting the members of the church next door. Most members have learned to keep their distance, but Sister Thomas is determined to open Mike's mind to GOD and religion. Connecting through a love for music she convinces Mike to pick up the Bible and start reading. He quickly learns that the Bible truly is a book of songs and slowly starts to believe in himself again. With the help of Sister Thomas, Mike stands up to his friends and begins to choose a more righteous path.

396729.title: Why Don't You Play in Hell?
396729.description: Ten years ago, the Kitagawa yakuza clan attacked the Muto yakuza clan at Muto's own home, only to have Muto's wife fight back. This unexpectedly left the Kitagawa clan in shambles, with their top hitman Ikegmai wounded and Muto's wife in prison.

396731.title: Song One
396731.description: Franny returns home when an accident leaves her brother comatose. Retracing his life as an aspiring musician, she tracks down his idol.

396732.title: Short Term 12
396732.description: Grace, a young supervisor at a foster care facility for at-risk teenagers, takes on the crises of two new residents while going through her own.

396825.title: Wolves
396825.description: After a tragic incident after discovering he is a werewolf, a boy soon discovers the truth of his family history amongst a town of fellow werewolves.

396826.title: The Love Punch
396826.description: When a divorced couple is bilked of their retirement by a wealthy tycoon, they plot to steal the tycoon’s diamond as payback, in this caper comedy.

396827.title: The Starving Games
396827.description: In this Hunger Games spoof, Kantmiss Evershot must fight for her life in the 75th annual Starving Games, where she could also win an old ham, a coupon for a foot-long sub, and a partially eaten pickle.

396830.title: Harlock Space Pirate
396830.description: Mankind is dying. Only one man can do anything about it, Space Captain Harlock, but the Gaia Coalition will stop at nothing to end him.

396831.title: Vehicle 19
396831.description: In Johannesburg, an American parolee picks up the wrong rental car that makes him, and his unwitting passenger, a target of the corrupt local police.

398629.title: The Woman in the Fifth
398629.description: Based on Douglas Kennedy’s best-selling international thriller, The Woman in the Fifth follows American novelist Tom Ricks (Academy Award nominee Ethan Hawke, Before Sunset, Training Day) as he arrives in Paris determined to renew a relationship with his estranged wife and daughter. When the longed-for meeting goes poorly, he ends up in a seedy hostel on the outskirts of the city. Unable to pay for his room and board, he agrees to work as a night guard at a warehouse for the proprietor (Samir Guesmi, Tell No One) and spends the hours writing elaborate, imaginative letters to his daughter. One evening, after he’s invited to a literary gathering, Tom meets Margit (Academy Award nominee Kristin Scott Thomas, The English Patient), an enigmatic translator whose magnetic presence and worldly manner intrigue the down-and-out author. She seduces him, haughtily dictating the time and place of their rendezvous in the Fifth Arrondissement. Their passionate affair coincides with a string of inexplicable events, and slowly Tom’s anxieties and inner torments begin to derange his sense of what’s real.

398864.title: Electric Burma: The Concert for Aung San Suu Kyi - Words I Never Said
398864.description: Bono and others in a major Dublin, city wide event in honor of revered human rights activist Aung San Suu Kyi.

399597.title: Big Village Lights
399597.description: Fedya is a 20 years old film fan. He loves movies, local beauty Zhenya and the small provincial Motherland  movie theatre that he has managed to revive. When the local authorities decide to turn Motherland  into a shopping mall, there is only one thing he can do: make a successful film with a top celebrity and pay off the crooked officials.

399602.title: Amun
399602.description: A desperate Russian tourist goes to the Monastery of Temptation in Israel to find an elder healer called Amun to hopefully save his dying son s life. His search leads him to the Judaean desert. Thirst and scalding sun bring the traveler to complete exhaustion but his son s life is at stake and there s no way back. Even though the protagonist does not believe in miracles he completes his journey and receives salvation.

399751.title: Heroes Manufactured
399751.description: Comic book artists reveal their secrets and abilities with breaking into the comic book industry while dealing with fandom, celebrities and the craze of comic book conventions.

400712.title: The March Sisters at Christmas
400712.description: This modern retelling of Louisa May Alcott's "Little Women" follows four sisters who learn that their mother plans on selling their beloved family home after the holidays. Hoping to keep the family under the same roof, the sisters band together to restore the house to its former glory. But the ups and downs of their personal lives lead to a falling out. Can the sisters come together to save their house-and their family-before Christmas is ruined?

400713.title: Holly's Holiday
400713.description: NYC ad exec Holly Maddux can't help but notice the hunky mannequin in the store front outside her office. One day, Holly slips and hits her head in front of the store, waking up to find a perfect gentleman at her side. Holly soon hits it off with her new man! But when she begins to discover the pressure to be perfect is more than she bargained for, she has to choose between the perfect life she's always dreamed of and the real love that's been waiting for her all along.

400714.title: A Puppy for Christmas
400714.description: All Noelle wants for Christmas is a puppy. But her furry friend is mischievous and gets them both evicted. Spending the holidays with her coworker, sparks begin to fly. When Noelle's ex shows up, she must decide which man she wants.

400715.title: Married by Christmas
400715.description: Carrie and Katie realize their family’s company will be inherited by the first sister to marry. With Katie’s Christmas Eve wedding already planned, workaholic Carrie sets out to elope before it’s too late.

400716.title: Girlfriends of Christmas Past
400716.description: A murdered police officer is brought back to life by a cold-hearted scientist to serve as "The Demolitionist", the ultimate crime-fighting weapon in a city overrun by criminals.

401315.title: Summertime Christmas
401315.description: While vacationing separately in small-town USA, Elwood and Nora, two of Santa's elves, receive an urgent transmission, initiating a series of events that will change their lives, and the world, forever. With the help of one good little girl, they set out to rid the town out of an economic depression and turn the wayward children back from naughty to nice. As their relationship blossoms, they discover the limits of their magic, the true meaning of Christmas and the joy of helping others.

401316.title: Saint Street
401316.description: Saint Street is a classic American Christmas tale for the entire family. The story follows Percy who is a good man, but has found himself caught up in the riches of the world and is neglecting his most prized possession -  his family.   Christmas Eve has arrived and Percy is still hard at work late into the night, once again breaking his promises to his wife and kids that he would leave early so that they could drive to their traditional family Christmas party.  After being warned time and again to change his ways from a heavenly being from beyond, Percy is about to experience some grave consequences for his actions.  In a series of tragic events, Percy faces humble circumstances after losing everything in a car accident -  his family, job and home. Paralyzed from the waist down and confined to a wheelchair, he is forced to be homeless and live in the gritty world of misfits on Saint Street.  It is on Saint Street where Percy sees the light and changes his ways through the examples of the most unlikely of souls. We soon discover that things aren't always what they seem and second chances and redemption just might be closer than we think.

401317.title: Miracle Maker
401317.description: The Miracle Maker is coming! If any town is in need of a miracle, it's Woodhaven, a tiny town hanging on the edge of the American frontier. It's nearly Christmas, but it's hardly a season of celebration. Work is scarce, money is tight, love is lagging, and spirits are down. Maybe the Miracle Maker can turn things around. The town anxiously waits for someone magnificent who can change their lives. But the ragged traveler who appears isn't who anyone expects - except for one small, silent boy and a precocious little girl. This man can barely take care of himself, let alone fulfill the dreams of others. But miracles can come in all shapes and sizes - and sometimes from unexpected people. Your entire family will love this Christmas tale of hope, love, and miracles.

401318.title: Mandie and the Forgotten Christmas
401318.description: When Mandie Shaw is thrust into Miss Heathwood's School for Girls, she struggles to grasp the school's new rules and the finer points of high society. As Mandie tries to stay out of hot water with Miss Heathwood and discover what the headmistress seems to have against Christmas, she stumbles upon a mystery in the school's forbidden attic. Will Mandie ignore the warning to flee or try to get to the bottom of the strange noises beyond the boarded-up doors? Uncovering the truth may lead to telling a lie, but it might also unlock the memories of a long-forgotten Christmas.

401319.title: Chasing the Star
401319.description: Three Magi Priests from different regions of the world journey through the unforgiving desert in hopes of finding proof of an age old prophecy. But Kings of men and fallen angels will stop at nothing to destroy the Magi and the baby boy they hold dear. These evils force the Magi to confront and make peace with old demons in order to prepare for the arrival of the new born King.

415644.title: Dinosaur Project
415644.description: Dinosaur Project is a team of explorers searching for a mythical creature. When their helicopter is brought down by a flock of enormous birds they discover strange creatures which civilization has thought extinct for millions of years!

418810.title: Don't Blink
418810.description: Ten people arrive at a secluded mountain resort to find it completely deserted. With no gas for the return trip, the visitors are forced to stay and investigate the mystery surrounding the abandoned lodge.

418820.title: Don't Hang Up
418820.description: An evening of drunken prank calls becomes a nightmare for a pair of teens when a mysterious stranger turns their game into something deadly.

02076.title: Dog the Bounty Hunter
02076.description: The world's most famous bounty hunter takes on adrenaline-fueled hunts from Hawaii to Colorado, alongside his wife Beth and their fearless family.

02166.title: Merlin
02166.description: The young wizard Merlin must keep his talent hidden in a kingdom where magic is banned as he and the future King Arthur face their destinies.

01546.title: Wolfblood
01546.description: Being a teen is hard but being a Wolfblood is even more complicated as Maddy and the others try to keep their shape-shifting secret from the world.

0972.title: Shameless
0972.description: Follow the rollercoaster lives and loves of a dysfunctional, working class family as they experience life on the edge.

01550.title: H2O: Just Add Water
01550.description: Being a teen is hard but these three girls are mermaids, and when they aren’t using their powers for good, they must keep their nature a secret.

0337.title: McLeod's Daughters
0337.description: McLeod's Daughters tells the story of two sisters who are reunited when they inherit a vast outback cattle property in South Australia.

065.title: Top Boy
065.description: A thriving but underground drugs business is being run by Dushane and his friend Sully. After their loan from the top don is stolen by a rival gang, the two swear revenge.

02072.title: Storage Wars: Texas
02072.description: The reality franchise heads to the Lone Star state to follow teams of bidders on their quest for unpaid storage lockers, sifting through trash for auction gold.

02067.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
02067.description: Yu-Gi-Oh! follows the adventures of high school student Yugi, who has a magical secret that comes to life when he plays his favorite card game: 'Duel Monsters.'

0167.title: The FBI Files
0167.description: This documentary reality series takes viewers behind the scenes of major crime investigations, as agents and scientists recount their forensic detective work.

01622.title: Naruto
01622.description: In another world, ninja are the ultimate power, and in the Village Hidden in the Leaves live the stealthiest ninja in the land. Twelve years earlier, the fearsome Nine-Tailed Fox terrorized the village and claimed many lives before it was subdued and its spirit sealed within the body of a baby boy. That boy, Naruto Uzumaki, has grown up to become a ninja-in-training who's more interested in pranks than in studying ninjutsu.. but Naruto is determined to become the greatest ninja ever!

01901.title: Bleach
01901.description: For as long as he can remember, Ichigo Kurosaki has been able to see ghosts. But when he meets Rukia, a Soul Reaper who battles evil spirits known as Hollows, he finds his life is changed forever when Rukia transfers most of her powers to him. Now a Soul Reaper himself with a new found wealth of spiritual energy, Ichigo discovers his true calling: to protect the living and the dead from evil. But when Rukia's actions are called under scrutiny, Ichigo and his friends must put everything on the line to prepare to save their friend from the harsh justice of the Soul Society.

01627.title: HUNTERxHUNTER
01627.description: Gon is a young boy who dreams of following in his father’s footsteps to become a Hunter. But first he must pass the notoriously difficult and dangerous Hunter Qualification Exam. Throughout his journey, Gon overcomes many obstacles, while making new friends along the way!

0400.title: Wilfred
0400.description: Adam is the only one who sees Wilfred, his girlfriend’s dog, as a man in a dog suit, in the original version of the Australian series.

0311.title: Home Movies
0311.description: Brendon Small, an ambitious eight-year-old filmmaker, shoots movies in his basement with his two best friends, while coming to terms with adolescence, life, and relationships.

0491.title: The Saint
0491.description: The Saint was a successful UK adventure series featuring Roger Moore as Simon Templar, a carefree Robin Hood type character, who travelled around Europe while usually trying to help out someone in distress.

01669.title: REBORN!
01669.description: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!

01823.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
01823.description: Based on author Hirohiko Araki’s groundbreaking Shonen Jump manga series, JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure follows the multigenerational tale of the heroic Joestar family and their never-ending battle against evil.

0312.title: ReBoot
0312.description: Join the fast-paced action and adventure as Guardian Bob and his friends Dot, Enzo and his trusty dog Frisket fend off attacks from the super-viruses.

0908.title: The Dick Cavett Show
0908.description: When Dick Cavett joined the late-night talk show parade in 1969, his intelligent wit pumped a much-needed breath of fresh air into the format. The Dick Cavett Show also became the late-night home of rock 'n' roll, with a guest list that reads like a who's who of the era's top performers.

0807.title: Durham County
0807.description: Detective Mike Sweeney moves his family to the suburbs to make a new start but the appearance of a local serial killer proves nowhere is safe.

02262.title: Dance Academy
02262.description: Fifteen-year-old Tara Webster has grown up on a farm in country Australia and has dreamt of being a dancer ever since she was a little girl. When she makes it into the National Academy of Dance - the best school in the country - she is sure her life is about to be spectacular. What Tara doesn't realise is how far behind she is in her training, and that there's a whole lot more to surviving the Academy than just dancing...

0811.title: Underbelly: Razor
0811.description: This drama tells the story of the bitter feud between Tilly Devine, running a chain of 40 brothels, and her rival Kate Leigh with an empire built on illegal alcohol, theft and cocaine dealing.

058.title: Five Days
058.description: Police investigators struggle to solve the disappearance of a mother in the suburbs.

0203.title: Wild at Heart
0203.description: The first series from television that follows the lives of the Trevanion family in the African Heartland.

01470.title: All Saints
01470.description: A drama series centred on the lives of the nurses at All Saints Western General Hospital.

02154.title: The IT Crowd
02154.description: A pair of dweebs squares off against their owner-come-lately and corporate life, with their tech-illiterate manager running interference.

0486.title: The Goode Family
0486.description: Meet Gerald and Helen Goode, a couple who live by the motto WWAGD (What Would Al Gore Do?). Theyre zealous vegans, they drive a hybrid, and they recycle everything possible. Even the family dog, Che, is vegan.

0446.title: Petticoat Junction: The Series
0446.description: Petticoat Junction follows the comical misadventures at the family-run Shady Rest Hotel, located in the charming farming community of Hooterville.

0189.title: Outrageous Fortune
0189.description: Award winning TV series. The Wests are a one-family crime wave with a proud tradition in thievery, larceny, and petty crime - up until now.

01560.title: Bob and Margaret
01560.description: Based on the Academy Award-winning short film "Bob's Birthday" created by David Fine and Alison Snowden, this charming, witty animated series focuses on the ordinary lives of a middle class dentist and his foot doctor wife. Together, they tackle such traumas as being burgled, going on a package holiday and deciding whether or not having a child will ruin their lives. They do all this with a gentle restraint and a keen sense of the absurd. Bob and Margaret provides a whole new way to look - and laugh - at life's ordinary occurrences that we all experience.

01508.title: Packed to the Rafters
01508.description: Packed To The Rafters is a drama-comedy that turns a microscope on the lives of would-be empty-nesters Dave and Julie Rafter. Less than forty-eight hours after their reluctant middle son moves himself next door, all dreams of freedom and personal fulfilment are put on hold as one by one their youngest son and his princess wife, troubled eldest daughter and Julie's emotionally vulnerable father return to the family house. Ensuring that once again they are literally packed to the rafters.

02086.title: Getting Doug with High
02086.description: Stoner-comedian Doug Benson hosts this web series talk-show, interviewing celebrity guests while smoking marijuana.

02077.title: Paranormal State
02077.description: Follow the members of the Penn State University Paranormal Research Society as they investigate alleged paranormal phenomena across the country.

02044.description: 20 different women line up to date rapper Flavor Flav and win his heart, but first they must compete for quality time by taking on various challenges.

0278.description: I Love Money is a show that gives 15 of the wildest and most popular, All-Star cast members from these of Love series, the chance to battle it out for a quarter of a million dollars.

02037.title: Real Chance of Love
02037.description: Since season one of this reality series predictably didn't end in a love match for Ahmad and Kamal Givens (aka Real and Chance), the brothers' search continues, this time with 20 new girls moving into the Stallionaires' Hollywood ranch mansion to compete for their affections.

0336.title: I Love New York
0336.description: After another unsuccessful try at love Tiffany "New York" Pollard is jumping back into the dating pool to find the man of her dreams.

0335.title: For the Love of Ray J
0335.description: 19 of the sexiest women from across the country try to tame the ultimate ladies man, Ray J, who brings these beautiful women to his home to see if he can find love.

0274.title: Charm School
0274.description: Thirteen of your favorite breakout stars from Flavor of Love seasons one and two are back for some heated competition. Living as a group, learning as a group and out for themselves, these former Flavorettes will be rigorously trained in proper etiquette and manners before competing in challenges to determine their poise and grace under pressure.

0280.title: Rock of Love
0280.description: Through a series of challenges, women compete for a chance to live with rock star Bret Michaels, who rose to fame in the 80s by fronting the band Poison.

02260.title: Figure 17
02260.description: Tsubasa is an elementary school girl who moved to Hokkaido. One night, she follows a shooting star to an spaceship

02261.title: I'm Gonna Be an Angel
02261.description: Yuusuke finds Noelle sleeping in the forest. Noelle's monster family has moved in. Dispel, trying to kidnap Noelle, sends all sorts of creatures.

02247.title: Tenamonya Voyagers
02247.description: Their school shut down, Ayako and Wakana are now stranded far from Earth. Enter Paraila, a wanted criminal, and they believe they can make it back.

02223.title: ItaKiss
02223.description: In the romantic comedy story, a high school girl named Kotoko finally tells a fellow senior named Naoki that she has loved him from afar since she saw him on their first day of high school. However, Naoki, a haughty "super-ikemen" (handsome male) with smarts and sports talent, rejects her offhand. Fate intervenes when a mild earthquake ruins Kotoko's family house. While the house gets rebuilt, Kotoko and her dad stay at the home of her dad's childhood friend...whose son is Naoki.

02246.title: Pandora in the Crimson Shell Ghost Urn
02246.description: A super-powered terrorist has threatened the island of Cenancle. To fight him off, Nene Nanakorobi, a cybernetic girl-next-door, will have to team up with famous inventor Delilah Uzal and her adorably grumpy cyborg assistant, Clarion.

02245.title: Handa-Kun
02245.description: Sei Handa is highly regarded at his school as a calligraphy genius. Despite his classmates’ praise, Handa is under the impression they all hate him! And when students begin challenging him, he’s sure he’s being bullied. It’s hard being so clueless!

02243.title: Dagashi Kashi
02243.description: Kokonotsu Shikada dreams of becoming a famous manga artist, but his real talent is selling the snacks in his father’s “dagashi” shop. He didn’t think much of it until a strange girl showed up determined to push him into the family business.

02242.title: Bikini Warriors
02242.description: Follow a party of battle-ready beauties as they make their way on an epic quest. The athletic Fighter, elegant Paladin, enchanting Mage, and fierce Dark Elf are ready to max out their stats and minimize every dungeon dwelling baddy out there.

0612.title: Inspector Morse
0612.description: Inspector Morse has an ear for music, a taste for beer and a nose for crime.

0755.title: Vera
0755.description: Detective Vera Stanhope is obsessive about her work but faces life with wit, guile and courage alongside Joe, her right-hand man and surrogate son.

01843.title: Crime Files
01843.description: Crime Files: The Homefront uncovers the most sensational stories of crimes committed against family members.

0524.title: New Detectives
0524.description: World-renowned forensics experts and criminal investigators solve murders and other crimes.

037.description: A committed and resourceful team of fearless homicide cops investigate action-packed murder mysteries and solve them with hard work, intuition and panache.

01767.title: America's Serial Killers: Portraits in Evil
01767.description: America's Serial Killers: Portraits in Evil will strip the covers from a world of profiling, forensic science and painful investigation as history's most brutal serial killers are exposed.

02254.title: Cold Squad
02254.description: A police drama focusing on 'cold cases' that have gone for years without a solution, brought out of the woodwork to solve, which may date back five to fifty years.

01637.title: The Prosecutors: In Pursuit of Justice
01637.description: THE PROSECUTORS, a serious/in depth series from New Dominion Pictures, explores the complexities of the American judicial system through the eyes of the dedicated men and women who work in it. This series is set amidst the grim reality of backlogged courts, the overworked police stations and on the hardening streets of America. It profiles leading prosecutors, as well as young attorneys just discovering the laws of the legal jungle. Viewers will hear the horrendous stories of the victims and their families as they turn to prosecutors in the face of tragedy, as well as the many judges, investigators and defense attorneys who work in this unique setting. This series will explore the relationships that bind these players, the tension that separates them and the inspiration that drives them all. It will define what makes the rule of law the powerful but sometimes precarious mechanism (or machine?) this nation has come to rely upon. THE PROSECUTORS is more than a series about crime and the people we entrust to protect us from it, it is also about justice, and those who bring it to light.

0128.title: Coffee Prince
0128.description: To avoid his family's pressure for him to marry, Han Kyul pays someone to pretend to be his gay partner. Trouble starts however, when Han Kyul begins to fall in love with him...

0757.title: Kill Me, Heal Me
0757.description: There lives a man who received a terrible scar during his childhood. Too young to cope with the shock, he unconsciously creates another personality to deal with his pain in his stead!Through this personality this man's hidden rage and violent nature explodes through. The problem is, he can't remember what this persona does. But wait... 027.title: Gu Family Book
027.description: A half man-half monster searches for a centuries-old book that, according to gumiho legend, contains the secret to becoming human.

0138.description: A chance meeting between the crown prince and the daughter of a nobleman gives rise to political strife, conspiracies, and a fateful love that surpasses even death...

026.title: The King 2 Hearts
026.description: Although a young prince shuns politics, he is thrown in the midst of a political turmoil with a female North Korean special agent. Will the unlikely duo overcome their initial animosity to find common ground?

0180.title: Empress Ki
0180.description: The epic tale of Empress Ki, the Goryeo woman who was sent to the Yuan Empire as a tribute, as so many women were back in the days. She caught the eye of the Yuan emperor, first becoming his concubine and eventually ascending to the position of primary empress.

028.title: Pasta
028.description: A workplace romantic comedy about the dreams and struggles of a young woman who aspires to become an elite chef.

031.title: Arang and the Magistrate
031.description: Set against the backdrop of the Joseon Dynasty, the story of Arang and Eunoh, is about fate, a truth greater than imagination, and the thin and often blurred line between life and death.

0122.title: 2 Weeks
0122.description: Tae-sang Jang is the perfect patsy to someone else's grand conspiracy, and soon he finds himself accused of a murder he didn't commit. Things are further complicated when he discovers he has a daughter who is suffering from leukemia and needs to be saved. Suddenly, he is a man with a mission: he has exactly two weeks to clear his name and save his daughter's life

0136.title: Queen's Classroom
0136.description: A teacher conflicts with her young sixth grade students with her rigid perfectionism and unique teaching methods.

02196.title: Mariana Y Scarlett
02196.description: Historia de dos hermanas que, sin saberlo, se enamoran del mismo hombre. Mariana y Scarlett son bonitas, luchadoras y con un gran deseo de superacion.

02128.title: La Teacher De Inglés
02128.description: Pilar es una profesora de inglés muy talentosa. Conoce a Enrique, dueño de una empresa textilera, su nuevo estudiante en el instituto de idiomas.

02030.description: Las ambiciones, la belleza y la búsqueda de poder son algunas de las condiciones inherentes a las vidas que rodean el mundo del narcotráfico.

02027.description: Historia de Julián, un ingeniero que es acusado de un asesinato que no cometió, en prisión conocerá a Esperanza con la cual entabla una relación.

02150.title: La Bruja
02150.description: Esta es la historia de dos personajes que influyen de manera contundente en el destino politico a finales de la decada de los setenta.

02151.title: Tierra De Cantores
02151.description: Emiliano Larios fue un joven cantante al que su familia educo para ser cura.

02127.title: La Bella Ceci Y El Imprudente
02127.description: El exclusivo hotel "El Castillo" está al borde de la quiebra y sólo una generosa inyección de capital puede salvarlo.

02026.title: El Cartel
02026.description: Con Pablo Escobar, fuera del panorama, nace el Cartel del Pacífico, liderado por Óscar Cadena, quien hace un pacto de negocios con Martín González.

02029.title: Los Hombres También Lloran
02029.description: Javier, un joven profesional que pensó que lo tenía todo, la vida le cambia de un momento a otro.

02028.title: Laura, una Vida Extraordinaria
02028.description: Hace 150 años, cuando la mujer era abandonada por la historia, nació Laura, una mujer diferente y especial que haría la diferencia.

01594.title: All Quiet in Peking
01594.description: In 1948, when the Communist Party was about to win the War of Liberation against the National Party, Meng'ao Fang was appointed by Chingkuo Chiang to lead an investigation into corruption, in the Peking Branch of Central Bank. Meanwhile, Chingkuo Chiang backed the monetary reform aiming at accumulating foreign exchange, while the National Party faced an economic breakdown. As the story unfolds, underground Communist Party members fought against enemy spies in rescuing the economy.

01685.title: Chronicle Of Love
01685.description: Linlang is caught between the love triangle of Emperor Kangxi and his cousin Nalan Rongruo. When she finally falls for the overbearing emperor, she finds out her lover is the person who issued the order to kill her family when she was ten years old.

02266.title: Field of Blood
02266.description: A young, female, feisty and funny trainee reporter, she often oversteps the mark between reporting crimes and solving them - while sometimes becoming part of the crime along the way.

02267.title: Hollyoaks
02267.description: The daily soap that follows the loves, lives and misdemeanors of a group of people living in the Chester village of Hollyoaks where anything goes.

02259.title: Teachers
02259.description: Teachers is the story of Simon and his mid-life crisis, despite the fact that he is only 27 as he deals with his work and professional life.

02233.title: Green Wing
02233.description: Green Wing follows thirteen main characters through the daily life of one of the world's most amusing hospitals.

02231.title: Don't Tell the Bride
02231.description: A young couple who are madly in love, but can't afford to marry, are given a large cash sum for the wedding of their dreams.

01730.title: Plus One
01730.description: What do you do when your girlfriend leaves you to marry Duncan from boyband Blue? You decide to outshine them on their wedding day.

02165.title: Men Behaving Badly
02165.description: Considering they're fully grown men, Gary and Dermot behave very badly indeed. It's due to the fact they share a flat and common interest in avoiding anything that involves responsibility. But what would you expect from two flatmates who relish late night beers, rambling conversations and the fruitless search for the perfect woman? MEN BEHAVING BADLY displays the sharp dialogue, engaging characters and effortless style which make a true comedy classic.

02158.title: Q.I.
02158.description: QI is the Rose d'Or comedy quiz show full of quirky facts in which contestants are rewarded more if their answers are 'quite interesting'.

02161.title: Hidden
02161.description: When a mysterious lawyer asks Harry Venn, a solicitor, to find a missing alibi witness for a client, he's forced to delve back into his murky past.

054.title: Spaced
054.description: Directionless Daisy Steiner and wired urban surfer Tim Bisley are twenty-somethings who lie about being a married in order to rent a London flat.

0472.description: Get those rock hard abs with this awesome series.

0465.description: Burn fat and build lean muscle while target-toning your abs, arms, hips and thighs! 3 high energy workouts maximize calorie burn while toning and tightening your entire body.

0480.description: Important yoga workouts to increase flexibility.

02092.description: Host Reshmi Chetram combines her love of Bollywood with her fitness addiction, giving you the workout of your life while leaving you feeling like you've just been to a Bollywood party.

02137.title: Chef Abroad
02137.description: Come along with Chef Michael Smith on his latest culinary adventure, as he circumnavigates the globe, meeting fascinating people doing amazing things with food, in unique and unusual places.

0296.title: Summer Kitchen
0296.description: A new video cookbook of delicious Summertime Recipes, perfect for your picnic basket or backyard bbq table.

0295.title: Holiday Kitchen
0295.description: Great recipes. We are a group of chefs and video folks that love to eat delicious healthy food and shoot it on video to share with you.

01019.title: The Cooking Lady
01019.description: The Cooking Lady presents a healthy approach to Southern cooking. Ann Hollowell's buzzword around the set is experimentation and that's exactly what she loves to do: experiment with some of her favorite dishes to make them healthier and, in most cases, better.

0921.title: The Maverick Chef
0921.description: Follow The Maverick Chef as he tantalizes the taste buds of viewers, food lovers, and restaurateurs across Asia with his visions of regional foods.

01979.title: Video Cookbook
01979.description: Discover the perfect dish for any occasion and be inspired with this decadent home cooking buffet of easy-to-follow video recipes from the very best international chefs. With dishes ranging from delicious desserts to quick & easy meals this is the must-have collection of short form recipe videos. And with each episode delivered with its own recipe card there's no excuse to stay out of the kitchen! Indulge in over 100 recipes - from quick meals and home cooking staples to exotic delicacies and Holiday favourites! Learn how to whip up an excellent Egg Nog, season a tangy Tom Yum Soup and cook the perfect abalone.

01974.title: Peta Unplugged: Culinary Adventures in the South of France
01974.description: Follow Peta’s culinary students, as they experience the gorgeous Languedoc-Roussillon, a region rich with wonderful food and sumptuous wines, and have cooking lessons in a rustic country kitchen. Peta’s home base, the medieval town of Uzes, is sure to capture your heart… along with all the people she meets … from rugged French cowboys, to salty seadogs, earthy farming folk, and some of the region’s top chefs and winemakers. It’s all presented with an abundance of flair and sophistication, and of course the irrepressible joie de vivre of the one and only Peta Mathias.

01106.title: The Alternative
01106.description: In this day and age where health costs are skyrocketing and western medicine is not all-inclusive, The Alternative, with host Tara Shah, is an all-new informative web show presenting natural, holistic, and alternative remedies to everyday health problems.

01663.title: FishNFire
01663.description: Series of N. American fishing featuring famous chef, fishing guide and world class athletes.

0797.title: Food Safari
0797.description: Discover the best of world cuisine that Australia has to offer as presenter Meave O'Meara, takes you into the heart of our cities and suburbs to uncover the very best in food from Europe, the Middle East, Asia, Africa and South America.

01992.title: Home to Flip
01992.description:
Host Peter Fallico teaches us how to find the right property, renovate it in a beautiful and cost-effective manner, source materials in the most unexpected places, and position it for the big sale. Each episode features one of his signature design projects, a contracting/carpentry project, tons of money-saving tips, and of course a breathtaking reveal. Peter must overcome a constant stream of real-life challenges, including today’s market, offering the audience an inside look at the adventure that is creating a successful
HOME TO FLIP.
